title: $\mathcal C^m$ solutions of semialgebraic equations on curves
summary: Consider a system of equations $A(x)\cdot F(x) = B(x)$ on a subset $X$ of $\mathbb R^n$, where $A(x)$ and $B(x)$ are matrix- and vector-valued semialgebraic functions on $X$, and the unknown $F(x)$ is a field of vector-valued $m$-jets. We assume there is a solution which is the field of Taylor polynomials of order $m$ on $X$ of a $\mathcal C^m$ vector-valued function $f$ on $\mathbb R^n$, and ask whether we can find a $\mathcal C^m$ semialgebraic solution $f$.
